artworks.title: Mountain of the Holy Cross, Colorado
artworks.medium: etching, roulette, and aquatint in brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams

artworks.title: His First Pipe
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 445 x 348 mm
Sheet: 622 x 490 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a young child standing with their legs apart, holding something in both hands close to their chest. The child has curly hair, wears a large hat, a loose, long-sleeved shirt, pants, and tall boots. The child is in a rustic setting, with a wooden structure in the background and straw or hay on the ground. Vines hang on the wall to the child's left.

artworks.title: Washington
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 585 x 485 mm (oval)
Sheet: 822 x 657 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man's upper body, including his head and shoulders. The man is facing slightly to the left, looking in the same direction. He has an oval face with prominent cheekbones, a strong jawline, and deep-set eyes. His hair is white or light gray, styled back with small curls on the sides. He is wearing a dark coat with visible buttons, a white cravat, and a high collar. The background is plain and neutral, contrasting with the dark tones of his clothing. The name "Washington" is inscribed below the portrait, along with additional text. The edges of the paper are worn.

artworks.title: Untitled (Niagara Falls)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 346 x 226 mm
sheet:  468 x 348 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall cascading from the top right to the bottom left. The point of view is from the edge of a cliff looking across at the waterfall. A towering rock face frames the waterfall on the right. The horizon is not distinct due to the focus on the waterfall. The sky at the top implies openness beyond the cliffs. The brushstrokes create a textured effect to depict the water and rocks. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and beige. Two figures stand on the ledge, and a bridge can be seen in the distance to the left.

artworks.title: In the Park, Dark
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an open park-like setting. The composition features numerous individuals gathered in an outdoor scene. The figures are concentrated at the lower section of the drawing where their lighter-toned garments and detailed outlines provide contrast against the dark background. Above the figures is a dark canopy or sky, with a faintly illuminated building in the upper center. The drawing captures a sense of social interaction or community within a park or garden setting. The style shows simplified lines and contrasts, enhancing the scene's atmosphere.

artworks.title: Housetops
artworks.dimensions:
image:  438 x 371 mm
sheet:  514 x 451 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of densely packed houses with flat and gabled roofs. The horizon is not visible, as rooftops dominate the frame. The artwork is a black and white linocut, featuring bold contrasts of light and shadow with angular lines. The rooftops create geometric shapes, with a woman and a man on a ladder indicating activity. The monochrome color palette highlights the graphic composition and play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Two Maples
artworks.dimensions:
image: 254 x 356 mm
sheet:  305 x 406 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed at ground level. Two large trees are in the foreground, framing the scene. The forest extends into the distance with more trees and wooded growth fading into the light. The drawing uses a pencil technique with delicate, soft strokes to create texture and shading. The black-and-white color palette emphasizes the play of light and shadow. In the distance, the trees are softly blended and shaded to suggest a receding perspective, leading the eye deeper into the forest.

artworks.title: The Cut from Culebra
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. A bustling industrial scene is nestled between mountains. Steep hills and rocky formations stretch horizontally across the image. Smoke and mist obscure the upper part of the view with no distinct sky visible. In the distance, jagged mountain peaks loom prominently with precise lines. A scene of intense activity unfolds closer to us, dominated by a steam locomotive and its ancillary structures on rail tracks. Billowing smoke adds dynamic movement to the composition. The line work is intricate with detailed cross-hatching and stippling techniques creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying intensities of grayscale giving the scene a dramatic and industrial ambiance.

artworks.title: Dinner Time, Gatun Lock
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a wide canal or construction trench viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is high in the image, emphasizing the depth of the trench and showing a vast landscape beyond with a suggestion of water and sky in the distance. Several large cranes are positioned along the edges of the trench, casting lines and shadows. The brushstrokes are sketch-like with dark shades to convey depth and texture, giving an impression of movement, especially in the swirling smoke rising from machinery inside the trench. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white to emphasize contrast and detail, creating a dramatic effect. Near the right edge, figures and equipment are visible, enhancing the scale and activity.

artworks.title: New York Towers from Brooklyn Bridge
artworks.medium: aquatint and etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows the view from an elevated position on the Brooklyn Bridge, looking towards the cityscape. The horizon is high in the image, dominated by tall buildings forming a jagged skyline. The scene is framed by the vertical lines of the bridge cables, creating a grid-like pattern. The artwork features a monochromatic etching or print style, emphasizing contrasts between light and shadow. The color palette consists mainly of black and sepia tones, creating a vintage aesthetic and highlighting the interplay of light on the structures in the urban landscape.

artworks.title: Tugboat
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 314 x 251 mm
Sheet: 400 x 284 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a bridge stretching diagonally across the scene from top right to left. The bridge's structure is highlighted with strong lines against the sky, featuring geometric patterns formed by the support beams underneath. Tall buildings rise dramatically beneath the bridge to the left. A boat emitting smoke moves through the water in the foreground. The image is black and white, emphasizing architectural forms and shadows in a dramatic urban setting.

artworks.title: Metropolis
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 305 x 227 mm
Sheet: 413 x 288 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban construction site with workers in action. A trench with pipes or rolled textiles is visible, along with a bridge structure adorned with diamond-shaped patterns. In the background, skyscrapers of various heights are present. Bold and graphic lines emphasize the industrial and architectural elements. The color palette is black and white, creating a stark contrast. Clouds soften the sharp lines of the buildings. The horizon is obscured by structures, suggesting a crowded cityscape.

artworks.title: Figure in Glass
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract composition of angular lines and sharp shapes that creates the outline of a seated human figure. The artwork resembles the style of cubist art with intersecting lines and overlapping planes. The figure's face and limbs are suggested through the arrangement of shapes, giving the impression of fragmented light on a surface or a puzzle.

artworks.title: Untitled (2 girls in a barn)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 445 x 632 mm
paper: 718 x 524 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. Two individuals are seated closely together under a shaded area. Both have long hair and are dressed in flowing clothing. The third person is seated separately on the right side, partially visible through an open door in a dimly lit interior space. They have short hair and are dressed in dark clothing. The background includes rustic elements like wooden beams and rough-textured walls, with pots nearby and shadows on the ground.

artworks.title: A Bunch of Pansies
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of five pansy flowers in various shades of black, gray, and white. The flowers are arranged centrally with two on the left, two overlapping at the center, and one on the right. Detailed textures and patterns on the petals create visual contrast. At the bottom of the image are a signature and date, "James D. Smillie" and "1890," as well as additional annotations.

artworks.title: On The Hillside
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 389 x 537 mm
image: 300 x 449 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This image shows a person sitting under large trees, facing a landscape. One tree trunk is detailed, with etchings showing age and strength. A path leads to an open area with smaller trees and rocks, extending to distant hills. The horizon is low in the composition, with the sky above. The colors are warm and sepia-toned, creating a serene atmosphere. The image is created using fine, delicate lines for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Untitled (Farmhouse, Long Island)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 235 x 352 mm 
plate:   255 x 358 mm
sheet:  331 x 451 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This image is a detailed etching of a rural scene. The view is slightly elevated, showing a small house among tall, leafless trees. The horizon is high, beneath a sky filled with wispy clouds. A tree with intricate branches stands behind the house, and a body of water reflects the surroundings. The artwork features precise brushwork, fine lines for texture, and a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Edgar Thomson Works, Bessemer
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 279 x 203 mm
Sheet: 331 x 231 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial landscape with an elevated view. There is a trestle bridge with a streetcar and structures below it. In the distance, factory chimneys emit smoke into a cloudy sky. The horizon is obscured by buildings and smoke. The artwork is in black and white, creating contrast. Fine etching is used for detail.

artworks.title: A Rustic Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a rustic bridge, a water stream, lush vegetation, trees, and cows grazing in a field. The sky is filled with expressive clouds and the artwork uses a monochromatic palette with cross-hatching to depict texture and detail.

artworks.title: London Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside dock scene with a busy waterway filled with ships and boats. A bridge spans the horizon with buildings and church spires in the distance. The artist used fine line work and a monochromatic sepia color palette for texture. Close to the viewer, smaller boats and figures are engaged in activities while larger ships lead towards the bridge and skyline.

artworks.title: The Big Mill, Gary, Indiana
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image features an industrial scene with towering structures and smokestacks. The horizon is obscured by dense smoke and a network of factory buildings. The drawing style uses cross-hatching and bold lines to convey texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with black and gray shades against a light background. Railway tracks lead towards a large industrial building, with smokestacks releasing dark smoke in the background.

artworks.title: Wintergreens
artworks.dimensions:
image: 283 x 428 mm
sheet:  430 x 530 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The view is from slightly above, looking down onto a sloping earth-covered landscape. In the scene, the horizon isn't visible. On the right side, a tree trunk with a hollow base is depicted with a gentle curvature. The ground is littered with stones and small plants, with several sprouting stems featuring five-lobed leaves scattered throughout. The brushstrokes appear controlled and precise, capturing fine details of the vegetation and ground textures. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on shades of gray. The largest leaf and various scattered small elements are closest to us, while the small plants, rocks, and tree trunk extend into the image, creating depth.

artworks.title: Costume Party
artworks.dimensions:
image: 307 x 420 mm
sheet: 400 x 575 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a party scene with various characters in costume. The image shows a theatrical setting where performers are gathered, with some dressed as clowns or in elaborate costumes. The central focus is on a group of individuals interacting closely, with expressive faces and body language suggesting conversation or conviviality. In the background, additional figures contribute to a sense of depth and a bustling environment. The composition is executed in a monochrome style, utilizing light and shadow to emphasize details and textures.

artworks.title: Cattle Ruminating
artworks.dimensions:
image: 287 x 203 mm
sheet:  356 x 280 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with two cows on grass, one standing and one reclining. The horizon is visible in the distance, separating the ground from the sky filled with clouds. Other farm structures and fencing are faintly seen. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes in sepia tones, creating an antique feel. Earthy tones dominate the palette, with shades of brown, cream, green, and blue-gray. A tall tree with branches and leaves is seen on the left side of the scene.
